changelog: Say "make it friendly" or "sound friendly" — or "বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ করো" / "আন্তরিক করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is rewritten in a warm, casual, friendly tone through Gemini with your own key. Gboard's Pixel 9+ writing-tools "Friendly" command, the fifth writing-tools rewrite after "fix it", "formalize", "shorten" and "elaborate" — the fix for a message dictated stiffly for a friend or family member. Keeps every fact, name and number and your meaning, only changes the tone; in Bengali it uses the warm তুমি form.
